text:
Mike (Sales): quick warm handoff for Sunridge (deal 4721). Signed POC for 3 months. Primary asks: hosted API + API connector, SAML SSO, and a dedicated capacity estimate for peak 10rps. Security is running a review this week so we might need an IP allowlist and SOC2 appendix. Credit terms signed. cc @Alyssa (CS)
Alyssa (CS): thanks mike — I got it. I'll own onboarding/contact with Sunridge PM. Proposed plan: 1) provision sandbox + API keys 2) SSO test 3) technical kickoff w/ eng/support 4) weekly health syncs. @Sam can you own infra ticket and preflight? @Nina for connector questions. Jade will do enablement docs.
Sam (Support): on it — i'll open ONB ticket and run preflight checklist. Quick Q: do they want VPC peering or just public API with IP allowlist?
deploy-bot: New ticket created: ONB-5872 · assignee: support-team · link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-5872
Nina (Eng): thanks — can you drop the API spec and expected token sizes? Also tell me preferred model size/quantization. If they want a 7B quantized variant we can prebuild a container; otherwise we'll serve hosted. Timeline?
Mike (Sales): attaching spec here: https://drive.redwood/sunridge/spec-connector-v1.pdf. Expect ~10 rps peak, ~2k tokens average per request. They asked for a 7B quantized model to keep costs low. POC kickoff target: next Mon. Security asked for SOC2 appendix and IP allowlist; they can provide the allowlist during kickoff.
Jade (CS): i'll schedule kickoff for Wed 10am PT unless anyone objects. i'll include Sunridge PM, Mike, Alyssa, Sam, Nina. i'll prepare an enablement doc + short demo checklist. also add onboarding checklist to CS playbook and create a feedback capture form for weekly syncs.
Alyssa (CS): action items (summary):
- Mike: confirm final contact emails and share SSO metadata by EOD today
- Sam: create infra preflight + VPC/IP decision, ticket ONB-5872, due Thu
- Nina: scope connector effort and estimate story points, reply by Thu
- Jade: schedule kickoff Wed 10am PT, prepare enablement doc, send calendar invites
- Alyssa: run renewal-risk watch (POC only) and weekly health cadence
Please mark owners on the ticket and add stakeholders.
Sam (Support): will check VPC need and update ONB-5872. If IP allowlist only, plan is public API + allowlist. If VPC required, need Dedicated capacity estimate from eng.
Nina (Eng): rough effort for connector scaffold + auth + retries ~3-5d (2 engineers), if we need Dedicated variant for quantized 7B add ~2d for build/qa. i'll post a small breakdown in the ticket. Also: any compliance tests to run during POC?
Mike (Sales): they want pen test report and SOC2 appendix. Pen test can be after POC but SOC2 summary needed for procurement.
Jade (CS): adding meeting agenda items: SSO flow, sample requests, rate limits, error handling, rollout criteria, feedback loop. i'll include sample cURL for smoke test in the enablement doc:
```
curl -X POST 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-q","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":50}'
```
Alyssa (CS): also capture renewal risk note: POC has limited seats and security timeline is tight — if security drags beyond 30 days, flag for AM and solutions engineering help.
Sam (Support): noted. i'll attach infra checklist to ONB-5872 and ping infra for capacity advice.
Nina (Eng): i'll add a small compatibility test script to the ticket and include an estimate for building a quantized container.
Mike (Sales): thanks all. i'll circulate Sunridge SSO metadata and PM contact now.
Jade (CS): perfect. i'll send invites + agenda. weekly sync starting next Fri. :thumbsup:
Alyssa (CS): thanks team — tagging this as "handoff: sales->cs->support/eng" in our tracker. please comment on ONB-5872 with any blockers.
Sam (Support): confirming ownership of infra triage.
Nina (Eng): will post estimates by EOD Thu.
deploy-bot: Reminder: onboarding kickoff scheduled Wed 10:00 PT — Calendar invite sent.
Jade (CS): closing loop — i'll post meeting notes and link to feedback form after kickoff.
Mike (Sales): :raised_hands: great - closing on my side.
